title: Upper bound on the field size
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers with $1\le k\le n$, and define $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, where the ceiling denotes the least integer $m$ such that $2^m\ge n$. Then $2^d\le 2n$.
